reviewNotes: Held back: the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000639 (the melody read from 000639a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 20); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Michael Weisse has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1531, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). William Henry Monk's dates (1823–1889) are from our page for the tune DIX (content/hymns/tunes/dix.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1861.
